name: @dsh-rc/protocol
description: Wire protocol for DSH Remote Control: sealed-record crypto, KDF, pairing URI, control frames, payload catalog, keep-awake command builder. Pure functions — no I/O, no timers, no platform symbols.

scripts.test: pnpm build && node --test dist/tests/keys.test.js dist/tests/record.test.js dist/tests/pairing.test.js dist/tests/frames.test.js dist/tests/payloads.test.js dist/tests/sleep.test.js dist/tests/ids.test.js
